story.title: Microsoft is giving Copilot more control over Windows and your files

facts.text: Copilot is where you interact with agents , and Copilot Studio is where you can easily create, manage, and connect agents to Copilot.
We’re introducing agents in Microsoft 365 designed to help scale individual impact and transform business processes.
These new agents complement the autonomous agents that we announced in October 2024 for sales, service, finance, and supply chain professionals—and we’re just getting started.
We’ll create many more agents in the coming year that will give customers the competitive advantage they need to future-proof their organization.
September 23 3 min read Building the system for AI at work There’s no shortage of sound and fury in AI right now.
Visit Microsoft365.com/copilot or download the Microsoft 365 app on your mobile device.
To empower every IT team to lead at scale, we’re introducing the Copilot Control System —designed for IT to confidently adopt and accelerate the business value of Copilot and agents.
Microsoft 365 Copilot is becoming a daily habit for people around the world—already, nearly 70% of Fortune 500 companies are using it.

Dow anticipates that Copilot will save it millions of dollars on shipping operations in the first year; at Bank of Queensland Group , 70% of users are saving two and a half to five hours per week; Eaton is speeding up internal documentation processes by 83%; and Accenture is going big, rolling out Copilot to 100,000 employees.

1 Blind, side-by-side human intelligence tasks conducted on behalf of Microsoft in July and August 2024, each with 9 participants (judges) to compare user satisfaction with query responses of Microsoft Copilot and a competitor.
At today’s Windows and Surface event, Microsoft showed off an upgrade to its Copilot AI system that will give it access to local files on your PC and the ability to take actions across the OS.
To show off how Hybrid Intelligence works, Jacob Andreou, Microsoft’s EVP of Copilot, walked through a video demo onstage asking Microsoft’s Autopilot tool to help with filing taxes.

Microsoft also showed off a new Windows search experience that lets you take quick actions from the search bar, like turning on dark mode, turning up your mic volume with an in-line slider, or even sending a text.
It’s part of an idea Microsoft is calling “Hybrid Intelligence,” where apps and tools rely on a mix of local and cloud AI models to accomplish tasks efficiently.
Features powered by Hybrid Intelligence will be coming to Copilot over the “next couple months,” Andreou said.

Microsoft wants its AI assistant to stop just talking about your computer and start operating it. 
 At its Windows and Surface event on October 7, 2026, the company showed off a Copilot upgrade that will let the assistant reach into local files on your PC and carry out actions across the operating system. 
 

 The upgrade falls under a concept Microsoft is calling “Hybrid Intelligence.” Under this approach, apps and tools draw on a blend of AI models: some running on the device itself, others running in the cloud, with the goal of finishing tasks efficiently. 
 Taxes, accountants, and an AI that reads your inbox 
 Jacob Andreou, Microsoft’s EVP of Copilot, handled the on-stage pitch.
He then asked the agent to help get her what she was requesting. \n Advertisement \n SEARCH Searching...
Microsoft can wire its agent directly into Windows, which turns deep OS integration into its main differentiator as demand grows for AI that handles complex, multi-step work.
He walked the audience through a video demo built around a task few people enjoy: filing taxes.
The company has built in several layers of control.
AI activation is opt-in, folder access is restricted, and Copilot agents operate under separate accounts from the user.
The Microsoft 365 Copilot user base remains small, with only a limited slice of users engaging with premium features.
© Decentral Media and Crypto Briefing® 2026.
Microsoft announced the Surface Laptop Ultra at the event, a machine equipped with Nvidia RTX Spark silicon aimed at improved AI performance.
Microsoft has also emphasized agent workspaces and user-controlled settings, designs intended to keep privacy and security in the foreground.
Microsoft logo (public domain) via Wikimedia Commons
Hybrid Intelligence also improves Autopilot, Microsoft's personal AI agent.
For those using Copilot for coding assistance, Microsoft says Hybrid Intelligence improves the experience in several ways.
Microsoft has unveiled Hybrid Intelligence, a set of software orchestration tools that will let your PC run AI models locally.
Microsoft says while Copilot will still rely on cloud inference for complex tasks, it can also run prompts against models running directly on your computer in cost- or privacy-sensitive scenarios.
This way, no information was sent to the cloud, further emphasizing Microsoft's focus on privacy and security in its AI advancements.
It makes writing native Windows apps directly from Copilot easier and safer with new Microsoft Execution Containers (MXC) tech.
